title: Retention and deletion

statement.en: A data user shall use shared data only within the retention period set in the contract and shall delete it when the period ends.

control: The connector refuses access after the period; deletion declared by the data user and checked on audit

expressions.note: The access window is E2. The delete duty inside the template is E1: the connector can't see whether the data was deleted.

source: DSSC rule record register v0.1, M3.policy.01 (retention as a minimum policy concept)
